fix: Size the batch from the known queue depth so the pushes in the drain loop do not regrow: `let mut work = Vec::with_capacity(self.bridge.queued.load(Ordering::Acquire).min(DEFAULT_UI_MESSAGE_BUDGET));`. Allocation remains only on the message path (take_turn runs from process_runtime_work_at on user events, not every frame). A caller-owned buffer passed as &mut Vec<UiWork> would remove the per-turn allocation entirely if this path is measured to matter.

Task::value() clones the whole stored AsyncValue<T> (including any Vec/String payload) on every read. Add a borrowing accessor and let callers avoid the clone: `pub fn with_value<R>(&self, read: impl FnOnce(&AsyncValue<T>) -> R) -> R { if self.handle.is_cancelled() { read(&AsyncValue::Error(TaskFailure::Cancelled)) } else { read(&self.state.lock().expect("task state mutex")) } }`. Keep value() for callers that need ownership. Public API addition, so it is additive.
